title: Initial Incident, Arrest, Witness Statement, etc. Reports: 2011 JERNARD WHEELER murder (Dekalb County Sheriff)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

I'm requesting Initial incident and arrest reports, all supplements and narratives, witness statements (written and recorded), and any 911 audio or body-cam video, & any redacted copy to the following closed case:

On March 2–3, 2011, following the shooting of 13-year-old Jernard Wheeler on McAfee Road in DeKalb County, Georgia:

March 2: DeKalb County police investigated the shooting and executed a search warrant at a residence on Willa Way.
March 2: Officers arrested Viola Goodman, 52, and her sons, Shontonious Hawkins, 25, and James Fanning, 20.
March 3: A 16-year-old suspect surrendered to police. Investigators believed he was the shooter

These details were reported by WSB-TV on March 3, 2011 and The Atlanta Journal-Constitution on March 4, 2011. Both reports attribute the investigation to DeKalb County police.

Investigating agency: DeKalb County Police Department, Major Felony Unit. Lead detective was Bruce Brueggeman& detective Joe Renaud was who obtained the necessary critical information, through interview, to obtain a warrant & make arrests in time.

The DeKalb County case was featured in The First 48.

It's Entirely impossibly that these records do Not exist. But if I've made a mistake in requesting from the incorrect agency please direct me to the right path. Likewise, If any records are withheld or redacted, please cite the specific exemption. Please send an estimate before incurring fees over $25. I prefer electronic delivery by email.

Again, I'm requesting Initial incident and arrest reports, all supplements and narratives, witness statements (written and recorded), and any 911 audio or body-cam video, & any redacted copy.

This here is information on the court case in which the incident is related. Provided in order to better assist you in locating said records:

Date of offense is March 2, 2011

Arrested 3/3/2011 (unindicted case D0219720, with Viola Goodman, James Fanning, and Shontonius Hawkins as co-parties);

bond denied 5/10/2011

State v. Viola Christine Goodman and Brandon Sharrod Alexander
— DeKalb County Superior Court, Division 7, Case 11CR2882, filed 5/20/2011, case type Murder, status Closed, Judge Daniel M. Coursey, Jr. (DeKalb County Judicial Information System)

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

Thank you,
Robbin Haynes

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robbin Haynes
